name: product-alpha
description: InterviewAce Product Alpha — Stage 1 of 3 (Alpha/Beta/Production). The first learner-facing InterviewAce experience: one complete 10-step coaching loop, built entirely on the founder's real flagship retry pair and Milestone 3's real captured Coach's Notes/Today's Focus output. No live input, no live LLM calls, no Decision Engine/Observation Engine/backend files touched. Standalone, sibling to every other prototype in this project.
